---
title: "Presidential Approval Ratings"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10

library(tidyverse)

# Load monthly presidential approval data (modern era where all 3 series overlap)
monthly_data <- read_csv("data/presidential_approval_by_month.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(year_month >= as.Date("1993-01-01"))

# Load congressional approval data
congress_data <- read_csv("data/congressional_approval_by_month.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(year_month >= as.Date("1993-01-01"))

# Load party favorability data
party_data <- read_csv("data/party_favorability_by_month.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(year_month >= as.Date("1993-01-01"))

# Single time series styled with clean Axios aesthetic
ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", color = "#D0D0D0", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_line(data = monthly_data, aes(x = year_month, y = approval, color = "Public Approval", group = president), linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_line(data = congress_data, aes(x = year_month, y = approval, color = "Congressional Approval"), linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_line(data = party_data, aes(x = year_month, y = favorability, color = "Party Favorability"), linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "Public Approval" = "#2E74C0",
      "Congressional Approval" = "#8338EC",
      "Party Favorability" = "#2E7D32"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(10, 90, by = 10),
    labels = \(y) paste0(y, "%"),
    limits = c(5, 95)
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "4 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(
    title = "U.S. Public, Congressional, and Party Ratings (1993–2025)",
    subtitle = "Monthly Gallup ratings for Presidential Public Approval, Congressional Approval, and Party Favorability; dashed line marks 50%",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Gallup Polls via DataCamp, American Presidency Project, & Gallup Historical Trends"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, color = "#1a1a1a"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "#555555", margin = margin(b = 12)),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.key.width = unit(2, "lines"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#ECECEC", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "#CCCCCC", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "#CCCCCC", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#555555", size = 10),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "#888888", size = 8, margin = margin(t = 12))
  )
```
